key_insight: Flide is an inference engine designed for branching decisions rather than text generation. Its central idea is exact state forking: reuse shared computation across decision branches while preserving output probabilities.
problem_solved: Generation-oriented inference engines poorly serve decision models such as Jev, either repeatedly computing shared prefixes or distorting the probabilities used to choose categorical outcomes.
method: Use exact state forking to support branching decision inference without repeatedly processing shared prefixes.
